memories.title: Delivery preference
memories.content: User Mira prefers release updates by email, never by telephone.

memories.title: Atlas production region
memories.content: As of September 7, 2026, Atlas production runs in westus3. The old eastus deployment was retired.

memories.title: Atlas deployment procedure
memories.content: To deploy Atlas: first validate the migration, then take a backup, then deploy the service, finally run the health probe.

memories.title: Atlas owner
memories.content: Mira owns Atlas. Mira's escalation code is AMBER-42.

memories.title: Atlas checkpoint
memories.content: On September 7, 2026, Atlas migration batch 17 completed. Resume at batch 18. Approval of the final cutover is still pending.

memories.title: Atlas previous checkpoint
memories.content: On September 6, 2026, Atlas migration batch 9 completed.

memories.title: Expense policy
memories.content: Habitat line items must be classified as business meal expenses.

memories.title: Orion region
memories.content: Orion production runs in northeurope. Orion's owner is Tomas.
